This small plot is mine, and I will do it the way I usually do when money is tight. I will plant my own local cuttings and mix them with the other crops, and I will use compost and household manure because I can gather that little by little. I will not buy chemical fertilizer, spray, or pay for outside labor, and I will wait for the rain because I have no water setup for irrigation.
